Name: SelectHammerstone
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SelectHammerstone_Description", "Examine river cobbles to find one with the right weight and shape to fit comfortably in your palm. Our ancestors spent two million years perfecting this selection - a good hammerstone becomes an extension of the arm.")

Name: StrikeFlakes
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "StrikeFlakes_Description", "Strike one stone against another at the correct angle to detach thin, sharp flakes. This simple act - discovered 2.6 million years ago - was humanitys first deliberate tool creation. The flakes produced are waste to the toolmaker but treasure to those who recognize their cutting potential.")

Name: ShapeChopper
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeChopper_Description", "Remove flakes from one end of a cobble to create a rough chopping edge - the defining tool of Oldowan technology. For over a million years, this was the height of human innovation.")

Name: ShapeScraper
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeScraper_Description", "Carefully retouch a sharp flake to create a steep, sturdy scraping edge. The Oldowan knappers discovered that different angles served different purposes - the scraper was one of humanitys first specialized tools.")

Name: KnapFlintFlakes
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapFlintFlakes_Description", "Strike flakes from a flint nodule. Flint fractures according to precise physical laws, producing edges sharper than surgical steel - a vast improvement over common stone.")

Name: KnapFlintKnife
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapFlintKnife_Description", "Carefully retouch a flint flake to create a durable blade with one sharp edge and one blunt edge for safe handling. The conchoidal fracture of flint produces edges only molecules thick.")

Name: KnapBifacialHandaxe
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapBifacialHandaxe_Description", "Shape a large flint nodule from both faces to create a symmetrical teardrop form - the hallmark of Acheulean technology. This elegant design produces four times more cutting edge than Oldowan choppers.")

Name: CookMeat
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CookMeat_Description", "Roast meat over the fire until done. The control of fire transformed human nutrition - cooking breaks down proteins, kills parasites, and releases more calories.")

Name: StripBark
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "StripBark_Description", "Carefully peel thin layers of papery bark from a birch branch. The bark separates most easily in early spring when the sap rises - a technique humans have used for over fifty thousand years.")

Name: ShredBark
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShredBark_Description", "Tear and shred birch bark to separate the inner bast fibers. These long, flexible strands were the basis of Neanderthal cordage technology - evidence of which dates back at least 50,000 years.")

Name: TwistCordage
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "TwistCordage_Description", "Twist fibers clockwise into yarn, then twist two yarns counter-clockwise together. This opposing twist locks the fibers in tension - a deceptively complex technique that enabled snares, hafted tools, and countless other technologies.")

Name: ShapeDiggingStick
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ShapeDiggingStick_Description", "Select a hardwood branch and sharpen one end to a point using a stone flake. This most basic of tools unlocks the calories stored in underground tubers.")

Name: SelectClub
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SelectClub_Description", "Find a heavy branch with good heft for striking. Sometimes the simplest weapon is best.")

Name: GatherTinder
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "GatherTinder_Description", "Collect fine, dry materials that will catch a spark - shredded bark, dried grass, or fungal amadou.")

Name: MakeFireDrill
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeFireDrill_Description", "Carve a straight hardwood spindle and prepare a softwood fireboard with a notched depression. The hand drill is one of humanitys oldest fire-starting methods.")

Name: MakeBowDrill
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeBowDrill_Description", "A bow-driven spindle generates more heat with less effort than a hand drill. The addition of a bearing block and bow transforms fire-making from exhausting work to reliable technique.")

Name: ScrapeHide
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "ScrapeHide_Description", "Remove flesh and fat from a fresh hide using a stone scraper. Speed is essential - an untreated hide begins rotting within hours.")

Name: BrainTanHide
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BrainTanHide_Description", "Work animal brains into a scraped hide, then smoke it to produce soft, washable buckskin. Every animal has just enough brain to tan its own hide.")

Name: HaftSpear
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HaftSpear_Description", "Bind a sharpened point to a straight shaft using cordage. The first composite tools combined materials with different properties.")

Name: HaftFlintSpear
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "HaftFlintSpear_Description", "Attach a carefully knapped flint point to a spear shaft. The flint tip penetrates far deeper than wood alone.")

Name: MakeSimplePouch
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSimplePouch_Description", "Gather a single piece of leather and tie it with sinew to create a basic container.")

Name: CraftSimpleBow
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CraftSimpleBow_Description", "Shape a bow stave and string it with twisted sinew or plant fiber. The bow stores energy for instant release.")

Name: FletchArrows
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "FletchArrows_Description", "Attach fletching and points to straight shafts. Fletching stabilizes flight through drag.")

Name: CraftAtlatl
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CraftAtlatl_Description", "Carve a hooked throwing stick that effectively extends the arm, doubling spear velocity.")

Name: CraftAtlatlDart
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CraftAtlatlDart_Description", "Make lightweight darts designed for atlatl throwing - longer and more flexible than hand-thrown spears.")

Name: MakeFishSpear
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeFishSpear_Description", "Create a multi-pronged spear for fishing in shallows. The spread of points compensates for light refraction in water.")

Name: WeaveFishTrap
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "WeaveFishTrap_Description", "Weave a conical basket trap that allows fish to enter but not escape.")

Name: KnapMicroliths
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "KnapMicroliths_Description", "Create tiny, geometric stone bladelets for composite tools. These small pieces maximize cutting edge per unit of precious stone.")

Name: SewLeatherTunic
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SewLeatherTunic_Description", "Cut and stitch leather pieces into a garment covering the torso. Sewn clothing enabled human expansion into cold climates.")

Name: SewLeatherTrousers
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SewLeatherTrousers_Description", "Stitch leather leg coverings for travel through brush and cold weather.")

Name: SewLeatherBoots
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "SewLeatherBoots_Description", "Create foot coverings from thick leather with sewn soles.")

Name: MakeBoneNeedle
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeBoneNeedle_Description", "Grind and polish a bone splinter into a fine needle with a drilled eye. This tiny tool enabled the revolution of sewn clothing.")

Name: CarveDugoutCanoe
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "CarveDugoutCanoe_Description", "Hollow a large log using fire and stone adzes. This labor-intensive process creates humanitys first true watercraft.")

Name: MakePolishedAxe
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakePolishedAxe_Description", "Grind and polish a greenstone blank against sandstone until smooth. Polished axes cut faster and last longer than flaked tools.")

Name: MakeCompositeBow
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeCompositeBow_Description", "Layer horn, wood, and sinew to create a bow more powerful than its size suggests. A masterwork of materials science.")

Name: BuildDeadfall
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildDeadfall_Description", "Construct a triggered trap that drops a heavy weight on prey. Passive hunting that works while you sleep.")

Name: MakeSnare
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeSnare_Description", "Create a noose trap that tightens when triggered. Snares catch small game with minimal effort.")

Name: WeaveBasket
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "WeaveBasket_Description", "Interlace flexible plant materials into a lightweight container for gathering and storage.")

Name: MakeWaterSkin
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "MakeWaterSkin_Description", "Clean an animal bladder or stomach for use as a water container.")

Name: MakeBarkContainer

Name: ForgeBronzeShield

Name: ShapeGlassBeads

Name: GatherHammerstones

Name: BuildCampfire
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildCampfire_Description", "Arrange stones in a ring and prepare a fire pit. The campfire is humanitys oldest technology - warmth, light, protection from predators, and the ability to cook food.")

Name: BuildForge
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildForge_Description", "Construct a proper forge with stone walls, clay lining, and bellows for forced air. This enables working with copper and bronze - the metals that transformed human civilization.")

Name: BuildBloomery
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildBloomery_Description", "Construct a tall clay furnace for smelting iron ore. The bloomery produces a spongy mass of iron bloom that must be hammered to remove impurities.")

Name: BuildWorkbench
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildWorkbench_Description", "Construct a sturdy work surface from logs and planks. A proper workbench provides stability for detailed crafting work and keeps tools organized.")

Name: BuildLoom
Description: NSLOCTEXT("Recipes [40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "BuildLoom_Description", "Construct a basic warp-weighted loom for weaving cloth. The loom enables production of textiles from plant fibers or wool.")

Name: BuildBasketContainer01
Description: NSLOCTEXT("[40E94CAC0878528FA6EFADE17AF8FFE7]", "A2129C6C4B76F53A4A66F1A697C5AC90", "A shallow basket woven from twisted plant cordage, built up in tight spirals where every pass shows the slight unevenness of hand tension. The fibers shift from sun-bleached tan to deeper brown, as if gathered from different plants or seasons, then split and rolled into cord by rubbing and twisting. A thicker braided rim stiffens the edge so it can be carried without collapsing, and small gaps between coils let grit fall through while still holding berries, nuts, or kindling.\r\n\r\nHistorically, baskets like this belong to the oldest layer of everyday technology. Fiber work often predates pottery because it needs no kiln and rarely survives unless preserved by extreme dryness or waterlogging. Cordage was a core survival skill for lines and lashings, and coiled basketry turned that same know-how into durable containers for carrying, storing, and processing food long before metal tools or written records.")

Name: BuildStickFloor
Description: A simple 1m square floor woven from green branches. Quick and easy to place — useful for testing building layouts before committing to heavier materials.

Name: BuildStickWall
Description: A simple wall woven from green branches. Stands on a floor or directly on the ground to enclose a structure.

Name: BuildStickRoof
Description: A 45° angled roof panel woven from green branches. Tiles edge-to-edge with other roof pieces to span larger areas; sits on top of walls and floors.

Name: BuildStickRoofPeak45
Description: A 45 degree peaked roof apex woven from green branches. Caps two opposing slope tiles meeting at the ridgeline; matches the roof tile snap rules and tiles end-to-end / side-by-side with other peaks.

Name: BuildStickWallHalf
Description: A half-height wall woven from green branches. Stack two on top of each other for a full wall, or use alone as a railing / parapet / window sill.
